record.bible_text: <FO><FO>A Psalm<WH04210> of Asaph<WH0623>.<Fo><Fo> The mighty<WH0410> God<WH0430>, <FI>even<Fi> the LORD<WH03068>, hath spoken<WH01696><WTH8765>, and called<WH07121><WTH8799> the earth<WH0776> from the rising<WH04217> of the sun<WH08121> unto the going down<WH03996> thereof. <RF>of...: or, for Asaph<Rf>
Out of Zion<WH06726>, the perfection<WH04359> of beauty<WH03308>, God<WH0430> hath shined<WH03313><WTH8689>.

Our God<WH0430> shall come<WH0935><WTH8799>, and shall not keep silence<WH02790><WTH8799>: a fire<WH0784> shall devour<WH0398><WTH8799> before<WH06440> him, and it shall be very<WH03966> tempestuous<WH08175><WTH8738> round about<WH05439> him.
He shall call<WH07121><WTH8799> to the heavens<WH08064> from above<WH05920>, and to the earth<WH0776>, that he may judge<WH01777><WTH8800> his people<WH05971>.
Gather<WH0622><WTH8798> my saints<WH02623> together unto me; those that have made<WH03772><WTH8802> a covenant<WH01285> with me by sacrifice<WH02077>.
And the heavens<WH08064> shall declare<WH05046><WTH8686> his righteousness<WH06664>: for God<WH0430> <FI>is<Fi> judge<WH08199><WTH8802> himself. Selah<WH05542>.<CM>

Hear<WH08085><WTH8798>, O my people<WH05971>, and I will speak<WH01696><WTH8762>; O Israel<WH03478>, and I will testify<WH05749><WTH8686> against thee: I <FI>am<Fi> God<WH0430>, <FI>even<Fi> thy God<WH0430>.
I will not reprove<WH03198><WTH8686> thee for thy sacrifices<WH02077> or thy burnt offerings<WH05930>, <FI>to have been<Fi> continually<WH08548> before me.
I will take<WH03947><WTH8799> no bullock<WH06499> out of thy house<WH01004>, <FI>nor<Fi> he goats<WH06260> out of thy folds<WH04356>.
For every beast<WH02416> of the forest<WH03293> <FI>is<Fi> mine, <FI>and<Fi> the cattle<WH0929> upon a thousand<WH0505> hills<WH02042>.
I know<WH03045><WTH8804> all the fowls<WH05775> of the mountains<WH02022>: and the wild beasts<WH02123> of the field<WH07704> <FI>are<Fi> mine<WH05978>. <RF>mine: Heb. with me<Rf>
If I were hungry<WH07456><WTH8799>, I would not tell<WH0559><WTH8799> thee: for the world<WH08398> <FI>is<Fi> mine, and the fulness<WH04393> thereof.
Will I eat<WH0398><WTH8799> the flesh<WH01320> of bulls<WH047>, or drink<WH08354><WTH8799> the blood<WH01818> of goats<WH06260>?
Offer<WH02076><WTH8798> unto God<WH0430> thanksgiving<WH08426>; and pay<WH07999><WTH8761> thy vows<WH05088> unto the most High<WH05945>:
And call<WH07121><WTH8798> upon me in the day<WH03117> of trouble<WH06869>: I will deliver<WH02502><WTH8762> thee, and thou shalt glorify<WH03513><WTH8762> me.<CM>

But unto the wicked<WH07563> God<WH0430> saith<WH0559><WTH8804>, What hast thou to do to declare<WH05608><WTH8763> my statutes<WH02706>, or <FI>that<Fi> thou shouldest take<WH05375><WTH8799> my covenant<WH01285> in thy mouth<WH06310>?
Seeing thou hatest<WH08130><WTH8804> instruction<WH04148>, and castest<WH07993><WTH8686> my words<WH01697> behind<WH0310> thee.

When thou sawest<WH07200><WTH8804> a thief<WH01590>, then thou consentedst<WH07521><WTH8799> with him, and hast been partaker<WH02506> with adulterers<WH05003><WTH8764>. <RF>hast...: Heb. thy portion was with<Rf>
Thou givest<WH07971><WTH8804> thy mouth<WH06310> to evil<WH07451>, and thy tongue<WH03956> frameth<WH06775><WTH8686> deceit<WH04820>. <RF>givest: Heb. sendest<Rf>
Thou sittest<WH03427><WTH8799> <FI>and<Fi> speakest<WH01696><WTH8762> against thy brother<WH0251>; thou<WH05414><WTH8799> slanderest<WH01848> thine own mother's<WH0517> son<WH01121>.

These <FI>things<Fi> hast thou done<WH06213><WTH8804>, and I kept silence<WH02790><WTH8689>; thou thoughtest<WH01819><WTH8765> that I was altogether<WH01961><WTH8800> <FI>such an one<Fi> as thyself: <FI>but<Fi> I will reprove<WH03198><WTH8686> thee, and set <FI>them<Fi> in order<WH06186><WTH8799> before thine eyes<WH05869>.
Now consider<WH0995><WTH8798> this, ye that forget<WH07911><WTH8802> God<WH0433>, lest I tear <FI>you<Fi> in pieces<WH02963><WTH8799>, and <FI>there be<Fi> none to deliver<WH05337><WTH8688>.

Whoso offereth<WH02076><WTH8802> praise<WH08426> glorifieth<WH03513><WTH8762> me: and to him that ordereth<WH07760><WTH8804> <FI>his<Fi> conversation<WH01870> <FI>aright<Fi> will I shew<WH07200><WTH8686> the salvation<WH03468> of God<WH0430>. <RF>that...: Heb. that disposeth his way<Rf><CM>
